summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Holdings Profile Access feature. All 11 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified for all three roles (Broker, Sub-broker, Client) - all can access full client profile data via GET /api/clients/{client_id} and GET /api/holdings/clients endpoints.
passed_tests: Broker authentication (2-step login with PAN/password and PIN)
Broker GET /api/holdings/clients - Returns list of all broker's clients (3 clients)
Broker GET /api/clients/{client_id} - Returns full client profile with 44 fields
Sub-broker GET /api/holdings/clients - Returns only linked clients (1 client)
Sub-broker GET /api/clients/{client_id} - Returns full linked client profile
Client GET /api/holdings/clients - Returns only themselves (1 entry)
Client GET /api/clients/{client_id} - Returns their own full profile
Client cannot access other client's profile (returns 404)
Profile fields consistency - All roles see same profile structure
UI: Broker Holdings page Profile tab shows all client fields (Personal, Address, Bank, International Bank, Nominee)
UI: Sub-broker Holdings page Profile tab shows all linked client fields
UI: Client Profile page shows all their own profile fields
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/clients/{client_id} correctly implements role-based access: broker checks created_by, sub-broker checks linked_subbroker_id, client checks user_id
GET /api/holdings/clients correctly filters clients by role: broker sees all their clients, sub-broker sees linked clients, client sees only themselves
No data filtering applied - all roles see the same complete profile fields
Frontend Holdings.jsx correctly calls /api/clients/{client_id} for profile data
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data - Test NRI Client (c83c99c4-f960-4631-bc6e-d94e4ac28a9f), Test Approval Client (11ea59cf-106f-418a-abfb-9488478afb55)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Holdings Profile Access feature fully tested. All three roles (broker, sub-broker, client) can access client profile data via GET /api/clients/{client_id}. The endpoint at lines 6736-6759 in server.py correctly checks: broker->created_by, sub_broker->linked_subbroker_id, client->user_id. GET /api/holdings/clients at lines 7971-7986 correctly returns filtered client lists based on role. Frontend Holdings.jsx at lines 83-115 correctly fetches profile data. No data filtering - all roles see identical profile fields.
